query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Conditioning saved via conditioning_saver and reloaded via conditioning_loader yields corrupted video (tearing/brown noise) vs identical live-encoded conditioning.

desired.outcome: NRTnarathip root-caused it: the saver persists only attention_mask and drops pooled_output/other cond_options keys, so denoising runs on incomplete text conditioning; fix posted as a fork with new 'LTXV 2.3 Save/Load Conditioning' nodes (unmerged, no confirmation back).
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: NRTnarathip root-caused it: the saver persists only attention_mask and drops pooled_output/other cond_options keys, so denoising runs on incomplete text conditioning; fix posted as a fork with new 'LTXV 2.3 Save/Load Conditioning' nodes (unmerged, no confirmation back).
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Inspect what the conditioning saver actually persists, discover it drops pooled_output and cond_options keys, and restore complete text conditioning (or use fixed save/load nodes).
